name: @winclip/api-client
description: Cliente TypeScript tipado de la API de WinClip generado desde OpenAPI

scripts.gen: uv run --project ../../apps/api python -c "import json; from winclip.main import app; print(json.dumps(app.openapi()))" > openapi.snapshot.json && openapi-typescript openapi.snapshot.json -o src/schema.d.ts
